notes.title: Introducing Velociraptor
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

We invite you to journey into the world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/][b]Dinos Reborn[/b][/url], where every step you take is a fascinating encounter with ancient beasts. Here, mysterious flora and fauna intertwine in an undiscovered ecosystem concealing riddles and dangers, ready to be explored by daredevils like you. In today's devlog, we'll look at the [b]Velociraptor[/b], which means 'swift thief' in Latin. What drives this darkly named beast? What secrets does it hide in its sickle-shaped claws? It's all coming soon, so get ready for a real dose of information to help you survive in the land of the dinosaurs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/98606e04ba2bb44ee3bad54dc84a6b59f3627405.png[/img]
[h2]Characteristic features[/h2]
Despite its small size, this dinosaur is an impressive hunter. The Velociraptor's feet are a small masterpiece of evolution. Three claws on the front of the foot, with a sickle-shaped claw about 12 cm long, make it a true predator. When running, it raises its murderous claw, ready to attack, and walks on two toes. This species is remarkable for its extraordinary speed.

[h2]Meeting places[/h2]
Velociraptors live in various terrains, from backwoods forests to dense jungles. Their nests, made from leaves, sticks, and feathers, are a testament to their skill at building shelter. While exploring the island, you come across scratches on trees in search of valuable materials, you are advised to move away. This is a sign that this dinosaur may be nearby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/ab375a4eb7dad1b2fc78453da928feee3f3364db.png[/img]
Aggressive and agile, Velociraptors will attack without hesitation when they see an enemy. Their speed allows them to dodge and attack at lightning speed. They may roar a warning before charging, but there's no need to wait - it's better to be on your feet. If you come across a Velociraptor on your way, think twice about whether it's worth risking a fight, especially as they often travel in groups. Their screeching as they run will make your hair stand on end. 

As you can see, the Velociraptor is not just a dinosaur - it is a living hunting machine, always ready to attack. Those who choose to face it must be prepared for a dynamic fight for survival. Stay tuned for the next devlogs as we reveal more of the secrets and dangers that await you in [b]Dinos Reborn[/b]! Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url] and add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/]wishlist[/url] on Steam! Stay tuned.

notes.title: Be careful!
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

Today we invite you into a world of danger, where horror and adrenaline accompany us at every turn. We are currently immersed in creating an atmosphere that will allow you to experience what it means to be both hunter and hunted in this wild dinosaur paradise.

[h2]Sounds of horror[/h2]
Our team of audio-visual work to create a true symphony of horror. From post-production to ambient sounds that will transport you into the heart of the dinosaur kingdom. Our aim is that every rustling leaf and distant noise will make you shiver, and the roar of the Tyrannosaurus will make you want to flee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/815877351cf4311ec3c9bdfb5a3372cb59ff2836.png[/img]
[h2]Varied maps[/h2]
Our island is a maze of shifting terrain and lush flora, and the dinosaurs you'll encounter are no accident. Each species has its own territory, lairs, hunting grounds and places to quench their thirst. You'll need to consider whether it's worth entering a T-Rex's territory in search of valuable prey, or whether it's better to avoid these areas from a distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/555d945d40e69efadfdfd33c063695ea2b867e00.png[/img]
[h2]Forget your routine[/h2]
We would like you to feel what it is like to be a true hunter, far from the safety of cities and the comforts of civilisation. It is important to keep an eye on your health, hunger and thirst stats, because if you forget to buy the right items, your last hope is to search the wilderness for rations, bandages or that essential bottle of water to survive. On this island, it's not just a fight for survival, it's daily life in a land where every decision counts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/78978958afbbb2aa02b0e6a995c057fda1c04e21.png[/img]
Our journey on this wild island has only just begun. Upcoming devlogs will reveal more secrets, challenges and exciting opportunities that await any daredevil willing to take on the prehistoric beasts. Get ready for the most realistic and dangerous adventure in [b]Dinos Reborn[/b] and don't forget to add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/]wishlist[/url] on Steam! As Christmas approaches, we wish all dinosaur lovers health, happiness and prosperity - in real life and later in our game! Until you hear from the Hunters!

notes.title: Introducing Stygimoloch
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

Last time we introduced you to the factions that you will be undertaking dangerous but highly rewarding missions for during your adventure in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/][b]Dinos Reborn[/b][/url]. Today we come to you with the introduction of another Dinosaur you will have the chance to meet as you traverse the unnamed island. [b]Stygimoloch[/b] - a dinosaur from the pachycephalosaur family.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/db85f46b85bcbd9dbd0c3d2da0fd0068b65f1bc0.png[/img]
[h2]Characteristic features[/h2]
Its name, Thorny Devil, is no accident. This dinosaur has distinctive horns on its head, giving it a diabolical appearance and serving as a great weapon. Stygimoloch is generally a shy herbivore that will not attack humans on its own. It avoids fighting, but if we try to take its eggs from the nest, it will first warn us by roaring, and if we do not leave, it will attack us until we leave.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oFCqqsF.gif[/img]
[h2]Meeting places[/h2]
Stygimoloch is most commonly found in herds, in wooded areas, and on beaches, where they spend time near water. They live in larger groups because they are not very strong opponents for us and other dinosaurs. If we come across a single one, we probably have nothing to worry about as they are easily defeated. However, it is important to remember that their strength and aggressiveness depend on their sex and size.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a43slZj.gif[/img]
As you can see, compared to the first dinosaur we introduced you to, the T-Rex, the Stygimoloch is a rather docile individual, living peacefully in its herd and feeding on vegetation. It's best not to disturb its peace, though, so think twice before accepting a mission that involves taking its eggs - it can get nasty. That's all for today from our dinosaur diary. Remember to add [b]Dinos Reborn[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/]wishlist[/url] on Steam. We'll be back soon with more news from the island. Until we hear from you!

notes.title: Military organization
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

Last time we introduced you to the characteristics of the king of dinosaurs, the T-Rex. Today we come to you with a description of the organization for which you will be carrying out various missions during your adventure in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/][b]Dinos Reborn[/b][/url]. 

[h2]Organization[/h2]
GEF is an organization dedicated to recreating dinosaurs from their biological DNA, which they found on one of the islands. Unfortunately, after losing control of the project, the company has been forced to hire some mercenaries (including you) to help them kill the menacing creatures, get the samples, and recover important documents left on the island. The organization is divided into three branches.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rv2cqAV.gif[/img]
[h2]Genesis Expeditionary Force[/h2]
A military faction dedicated to fighting fierce and dangerous dinosaurs. Your mission is to recover important documents containing confidential information about military strategies, new technologies, and weapons. Find them, deliver them to the right people, and make sure they do not fall into the wrong hands. The missions you receive from the military faction are extremely dangerous and require meticulous planning and decisive action. Your skill, courage, and determination will be key in these missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/47fa0eb24ce1645f57dd8f4341d103dceaad8de9.png[/img]

[h2]Genesis BioVentures [/h2]
A faction dedicated to the study of flora and fauna. Their goal is to collect samples of the island's flora and fauna for vital research. Explore unknown territories, find the necessary research materials and contribute to the advancement of science. Be prepared to work in harsh weather conditions and challenging terrain during these missions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/e3e1100a23e8676b06030f50bc0b4ca057c1ed6e.png[/img]

[h2]Genesis BioPharma[/h2]
The faction is focused on creating medicines and pharmaceuticals from dinosaur blood. As a mercenary, you'll collect the blood of various dinosaur species and acquire medicines from the island that are essential for saving lives and curing diseases. You can also expect to be tasked with delivering research files essential to the creation of biological weapons and soldier enhancers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/4726c5e47bdefaa5ddfc6c42692002a518773a94.png[/img]

As a mercenary, you can earn cash rewards for completing missions, which you can use to buy better equipment. The difficulty of the missions is similar for each faction but increases as you progress. Remember to prepare well, it is better not to rely on luck in this case. That's it for today, thank you for your attention, and see you in the next devlog! Remember to add [b]Dinos Reborn[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/]Wish List[/url] on Steam and join our [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Introducing T-Rex
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

Today we would like to tell you about one of the most iconic beasts in our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/][b]Dinos Reborn[/b][/url]. You are looking at the Tyrannosaurus Rex - you can call it the king of all dinosaurs. Read carefully, as this knowledge may come in handy when you reach the island.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5uqNOFY.gif[/img]
[h2]Recognition and uniqueness[/h2]
One of the main challenges in designing the T-Rex was to keep it recognizable. A key element that sets it apart from other species is the pointed spikes on its skull, which give it a predatory appearance.

[h2]Meeting places[/h2]
Tyrannosaurus can be found in many parts of the island, but it usually hunts in less wooded areas where its prey is less likely to find shelter. Its huge silhouette makes it easy to spot its prey. Other dinosaurs respect this giant carnivore and flee in terror at the sound of its approaching footsteps. When everything on the horizon suddenly goes black, you know danger is approaching.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/c67bdd85b14b21da15f3a026c6ad4042dff68830.png[/img]
[h2]Danger [/h2]
The T-Rex is one of the fiercest dinosaurs on the island. Despite its enormous size, it is very fast and has excellent eyesight. Its powerful jaws are quick to destroy the lives of unwary adventurers. There is little chance of defeating the Tyrannosaurus in direct combat. To increase their chances, players must plan their encounters carefully.

[h2]Characteristic features[/h2]
Of all the dinosaurs on the island, the Tyrannosaurus stands out not only for its size but also for its aggressive behavior. It is capable of pouncing on prey that has carelessly entered its hunting territory. Its thick hide makes it resistant to most of the weapons available to mercenaries on the island. If you opt for an ordinary assault rifle and aim for sensitive areas such as the head or abdomen, you have little chance of bringing this beast down. Large-caliber shotguns are a much better choice. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/e8056773292ad06cff5045eaee20b2ad696a54a3.png[/img]
Remember, the T-Rex in [b]Dinos Reborn[/b] is a dangerous opponent, but with the right preparation and weapons, you can stand up to it. We will soon be introducing you to other dinosaurs you will encounter on the island. Remember to add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/]wishlist[/url] on Steam and visit us on [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url]. See you there!

notes.title: Secrets of defence
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

Today we have prepared some essential information to help you survive in this wild and dangerous world ruled by predatory dinosaurs. You need to learn the secrets of defending yourself against these beasts, so today we're going to give you a lesson on the weapons you'll encounter in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/][b]Dinos Reborn[/b][/url]. 

[h2]Purchase of weapons[/h2]
At the start of the game, you will only receive a Colt M1911 pistol, so we recommend that you approach your first expeditions with caution. To increase your chances of survival and improve your range, you must complete paid or weapon-rewarded missions or search various locations. When you return to the island, you can buy a new toy from the vendor, but remember that if you die while hunting, all your equipment will be lost.

[h2]Available range[/h2]
Several well-known and respected military weapons will be available in the game. You will be able to choose from the: 
[list]
[*] machine guns,
[*] sniper rifles,
[*] shotguns,
[*] pistols,
[*] crossbows.
[/list]
Models include classics such as the SCAR-L, Remington Model 700, and Winchester Model 1897, as well as a variety of traps and grenades to help you hunt dinosaurs and survive in the wild jungle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/5ae779401dfb6deb40a897fbf7ae7477f88a53ad.png[/img]
[h2]Modifications[/h2]
Weapons will have different modifications that will improve their performance and allow you to tailor the weapon to your liking or the mission at hand.
The modifications will include
[list]
[*] weapon sights,
[*] weapon mounts,
[*] torch,
[*] laser sight,
[*] suppressors,
[*] variable capacity magazines,
[*] gun barrels.
[/list]
[h2]Preferences[/h2]
Each weapon will allow you to fight any type of dinosaur, but its effectiveness will change drastically. For example, a modern sniper rifle will allow you to kill a larger dinosaur with a single accurate headshot. With the simpler Remington Model 700, killing larger dinosaurs will require several shots, which can be crucial to surviving a confrontation with a dangerous dinosaur.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/074604888d72ce7f82c5d7b055e81cfdadc72659.png[/img]
We hope you have been taking notes because this knowledge will come in handy in this unpredictable world full of threats. Being well-prepared for a mission is the key to a successful hunt, so don't skimp on equipping yourself with the perfect mix of weapons. We'll be back soon with more information on [b]Dinos Reborn[/b], so be sure to add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/]wishlist[/url] on Steam! notes.title: Working on the beasts
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

As the devlogs appear once a month, we want you to have a more detailed insight into the development process of our game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/][b]Dinos Reborn[/b][/url]. Today we want to tell you a little bit about what we are working on now and what we have planned for the near future.

[h2]The first dinosaurs[/h2]
Have you ever wondered how the first dinosaurs were created? We don't know, but we can tell you how we create our beasts for the game. We are currently working on creating high-quality 3D models of our dinosaurs. We pay particular attention to detail and accuracy in depicting the appearance of each species, based on film and book sources. We then adapt the models to the requirements of computer games and optimize them for game engines.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z8XiVeh.gif[/img]
[h2]Animations[/h2]
After creating the low-poly medley, we move on to preparing the dinosaur's skeleton, which allows us to introduce realistic animations. When creating these, detail is extremely important, as well as readability for the players. We want it to be easy to read a dinosaur's intentions, such as whether it has spotted us, what attack it is preparing, or whether it is hostile.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WYp9ibA.gif[/img]
[h2]The near future[/h2]
In the near future, we will be focusing on improving and balancing the hunting system, which is a key element of our game. Among other things, you will be able to follow the tracks of dinosaurs or detect their lairs. We also want to spend a lot of time on the level design of the map to make it as interesting and engaging as possible and to give you a sense of excitement as you explore. We want the locations to intrigue you, and encourage you to explore and discover all the secrets of the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/291ad6c6826d90fe482813953fafa0bcbb50a043.jpg[/img]
As you can see, we have a lot going on here. Work is in progress and we are doing our best to bring you as much good entertainment as possible! notes.title: Beginning of the expedition
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

Welcome back to another [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/][b]Dinos Reborn[/b][/url] devlog. Today we're going to tell you a bit about the main character and the factions you'll meet during your adventure in a dangerous world overrun by dinosaurs. You're probably curious about what you'll find on this wild and dangerous island, so let's get started!

[h2]Character creator[/h2]
At the start of the game, you will have the opportunity to customise your character and give it a unique look. With the help of a special wizard, you will be able to choose from a variety of head, shirt, trouser and backpack presets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/abfca29e0073689a1ece6ccaa6077c6145c798f7.png[/img]
[h2]Stats[/h2]
To survive, remember that dinosaurs aren't the only threat to your health. Watch out for steep climbs and keep an eye on your stamina, as you can't afford to be short on it when it comes to escaping. Staying hydrated and satisfying your hunger is just as important, so remember to take food with you, and just in case, look for something edible on the island - it might not turn out to be poisonous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/bd7fa249d500e63eea4cc3fc335f6e25a13ac01a.png[/img]
[h2]Organisation[/h2]
In the game, we take on the role of a mercenary working for an organisation that was working to recreate dinosaurs from their biological DNA found on one of the islands. Unfortunately, after losing control, it was up to the mercenaries to help eradicate the remaining dinosaurs and recover important documents that should not see the light of day. The organisation is divided into three branches that focus on fighting dangerous dinosaurs, studying flora and fauna, and creating medicines from the blood of wild units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/d7fe8ad1aaa4f741aac9b87cf454493bff285116.png[/img]
We are excited to share new information about our game with you. Stay tuned for the next devlog and get ready for unforgettable adventures in a world full of dinosaurs. Remember to add [b]Dinos Reborn[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1522360/Dinos_Reborn/]wishlist[/url] on Steam to stay up to date and join our [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Broken trail
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Hunters,[/h1]

We apologize for our lack of communication with you! Our absence is because we are working hard on our production all the time. The project is alive and well, our concept has changed, but we will inform you about it soon. 

We are committed to making [b]Dinos Reborn[/b] not just another game about dinosaurs, but a unique and prosperous world, the exploration of which will enable you to experience memorable adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/460a63b77da05bc86beec384a86a62a4ec7f1811.png[/img]
[h2]The survival instinct[/h2]
Dinosaurs may not have been very intelligent, but they had their own natural and unique call that guided them. Implementing artificial intelligence for such creatures is quite a challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/16e743e2a4b556b8e07945f7d38f3f377bbd73ef.png[/img]
[h2]Uniqueness[/h2]
We strive to make each reptile unique. We want them to have behaviors and habits that correspond only to their species. This will make battles with them even more interesting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39940250/43102e1723fbd341e69f2ab5503f053051938b39.png[/img]
[h2]See You![/h2]
We still have a lot of work ahead of us to make the game meet our and yours expectations! We will try to give you more information soon. We are preparing some surprises for you, so stay tuned!


Greetings,
[i]Team Dinos Reborn[/i]
